task.description: Security-review REQ-188's tenant-data-path changes against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md (INV-4/INV-7/INV-8 apply today). This is a hard gate before REVIEWER and before TEST-DESIGNER starts.
acceptance_criteria: Verify Letflow.Scheduler.run_retention_sweep/1 only ever touches the single tenant schema it is invoked for -- confirm the prefix: tenant_schema argument passed to Letflow.EventStore.archive/1 is never a cross-tenant value, and that Letflow.Scheduler.Poller's new retention-sweep step in handle_info(:tick, state) calls run_retention_sweep/1 once per schema in a per-schema loop (Enum.each), never with a combined/batched schema list.

Verify retention is genuinely disabled by default: Letflow.Scheduler.retention_enabled?/0 returns false with no config set (scheduler_config()[:retention_enabled] || @default_retention_enabled, @default_retention_enabled == false), and that no code path in poller.ex or scheduler.ex calls run_retention_sweep/1 or EventStore.archive/1 unconditionally -- the guard in maybe_run_retention_sweep/2 is the ONLY call site.

Verify maybe_rearm_timer/3 never leaks a re-armed timer row across tenant schemas -- confirm build_rearm_attrs/2 carries tenant_id/instance_id forward from the fired_timer struct (never re-derived from any other source) and the insert uses Repo.insert(changeset, prefix: tenant_schema) with the same tenant_schema the firing transaction itself is already scoped to.

Confirm no route/controller file was added or modified, and lib/letflow/application.ex has zero diff (git diff --stat against this run's commits) -- both are acceptance criteria (AC 7, AC 9) and also relevant to attack-surface review.

Confirm the moduledoc's flagged deviation section (actor_id sentinel, pre-existing from REQ-187) is unaffected by this change, and that the new moduledoc additions (partition-retention deferral, SCH-04 deferral) do not themselves introduce or paper over a security gap.
Route to REVIEWER next on PASS; route back to ELIXIR-DEV with specific findings on FAIL.
